result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a residential intersection with a vehicle traffic signal but a complete absence of dedicated pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, signals, or curb ramps. While sidewalks are present, the lack of crossing protection at a signalized junction creates a significant safety gap for residents.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path across the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway and side street at the intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: Pedestrians must rely on vehicle signals, which do not provide dedicated time or clear indication for safe crossing movements.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install ladder or zebra-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals and improve predictability.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and slow turning vehicles at the intersection corners.

result.summary: The intersection is located in a residential area and features basic infrastructure such as sidewalks and curb ramps with tactile warnings. However, it lacks marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle traffic lights for crossing cues.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve safety and predictability for walkers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten crossing distances and improve sight lines by preventing parking too close to the corner.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection that lacks essential pedestrian infrastructure, including marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While traffic lights are present to control vehicle flow, the environment is hostile to pedestrians due to the lack of designated crossing areas and guidance.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, which fails to alert drivers to potential pedestrian crossings and provides no designated path for people on foot.
hazards.location_in_image: Across all legs of the intersection in the foreground and midground.

hazards.name: Missing pedestrian signals
hazards.description: The intersection lacks pedestrian signal heads, leaving pedestrians without information on when it is safe to cross relative to vehicle signal phases.
hazards.location_in_image: On the traffic signal poles at the intersection corners.

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear in the asphalt surface can create trip hazards for pedestrians and uneven surfaces for those with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the intersection area and along the roadway edges.

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Apply continental or ladder-style pavement markings to all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Add Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals and improve safety at the signalized junction.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Ensure all corners have detectable warning surfaces and appropriate slopes to facilitate safe crossing for all users.
